messages.content:
You are AutoSkill's Document Skill Compiler.
Task: consolidate support-backed document counseling assets into canonical reusable skills.
Output ONLY strict JSON parseable by json.loads.
Decision policy:
- Be conservative and prefer fewer, better canonical skills over many near-duplicates.
- Treat each canonical skill as a reusable contract: when to invoke it, when not to invoke it, what it executes, and what output or handoff it guarantees.
- Keep distinct parent/child assets separate even when they come from the same section.
Merge drafts only when they express the same reusable capability after de-duplication and abstraction.
Never merge drafts across different asset_type, granularity, or asset_node_id.
Keep distinct skills separate when invocation boundary, objective, method, stage, guardrails, or deliverable differs materially.
Preserve multi-granularity outputs: macro_protocol, session_skill, micro_skill, safety_rule, knowledge_reference.
Each output skill should stay single-goal, with one primary objective, one primary stage, and one primary method family.
Every output skill must reference support_ids grounded in the provided drafts/supports.
support_ids must be chosen only from the provided supports.
source_draft_ids must be chosen only from the provided drafts.
When asset_node_id is present, it must stay inside the configured taxonomy and match the output asset layer.
Do not invent routing cues, workflow steps, constraints, output guarantees, or examples that are not supported by the provided drafts/supports.
Return JSON as {"skills": [...]}.
Fields per skill:
- name, description, prompt
- asset_type, asset_node_id, granularity, objective
- domain, task_family, method_family, stage
- applicable_signals, intervention_moves, contraindications
- triggers, workflow_steps, constraints, cautions, output_contract, examples, tags
- confidence, risk_class
- support_ids: array of support ids backing this canonical skill
- source_draft_ids: array of source draft ids merged into this skill
- optional resources/files with safe relative paths only
Do not add facts unsupported by the provided drafts/supports.

{"drafts": [{"draft_id": "3544270b-386b-5dc8-880e-a183a046444f", "doc_id": "f7a76d82-16fa-5d4e-9e08-dcfb60e9f311", "name": "Feed URI 动态参数注入", "description": "通过定义 uri_params 函数并配置 FEED_URI_PARAMS，将爬虫运行时属性（如 spider.name）动态注入到 feed 导出 URI 中，实现按爬虫或运行上下文区分的动态导出文件名。适用于多个爬虫共用同一导出命令但需区分输出文件，或需要在导出文件名中包含运行时属性的场景。", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "granularity": "micro", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "asset_path": "family_root/macro_skill/workflow_skill/micro_skill_node", "asset_level": 3, "visible_role": "leaf", "objective": "让 feed 导出 URI 能引用运行时爬虫属性，实现动态文件名", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "feed_export", "method_family": "uri_parameterization", "stage": "export_configuration", "applicable_signals": ["导出文件名需要随爬虫或运行上下文变化", "多个爬虫共用同一导出命令但需区分输出文件"], "contraindications": ["导出路径为固定静态值，无需运行时变量", "无法在项目中定义可导入的 Python 函数"], "intervention_moves": ["定义 uri_params(params, spider) 函数并合并运行时属性", "在 settings 中设置 FEED_URI_PARAMS 指向该函数导入路径", "在导出 URI 中使用 %(spider_name)s 占位符"], "workflow_steps": ["在项目中定义可导入的 uri_params(params, spider) 函数，返回 {**params, "spider_name": spider.name} 等合并字典", "在 settings 中设置 FEED_URI_PARAMS = "<module.path>.uri_params"", "在导出 URI 中使用 %(spider_name)s 占位符，如 scrapy crawl <spider_name> -o "%(spider_name)s.jsonl"", "运行导出并确认占位符被替换为实际爬虫属性值"], "triggers": ["需要在导出文件名中包含爬虫名称或其他运行时属性", "多个爬虫共用同一导出命令但需区分输出文件"], "constraints": ["uri_params 函数必须可被导入，FEED_URI_PARAMS 使用导入路径字符串", "URI 占位符名称须与函数返回字典中的键一致"], "cautions": ["若函数不可导入或路径错误，占位符将无法解析"], "output_contract": ["配置好的 uri_params 函数与 FEED_URI_PARAMS 设置，导出 URI 中 %(spider_name)s 被正确替换为运行时爬虫属性值"], "examples": [{"input": "需要在导出文件名中包含爬虫名称", "output": "定义 uri_params 返回 {**params, "spider_name": spider.name}，设置 FEED_URI_PARAMS = "myproject.utils.uri_params"，使用 -o "%(spider_name)s.jsonl"", "notes": "占位符名称须与函数返回字典键一致"}], "risk_class": "low", "confidence": 0.85, "support_ids": ["e00b492a-21fb-5848-b6dd-66d69c5cf830"], "metadata": {"prompt": "当需要让 feed 导出 URI 引用运行时爬虫属性时执行本微技能：
1. 在项目中定义一个可导入的 uri_params(params, spider) 函数，返回合并了运行时属性的字典，例如 {**params, "spider_name": spider.name}。
2. 在 settings 中将 FEED_URI_PARAMS 指向该函数的导入路径字符串（如 "myproject.utils.uri_params"）。
3. 在导出 URI 中使用 %(spider_name)s 占位符，例如 scrapy crawl <spider_name> -o "%(spider_name)s.jsonl"。
4. 验证导出时占位符被正确替换为实际爬虫属性值。", "tags": ["scrapy", "feed_export", "uri_parameterization", "export_configuration"], "files": {}, "resources": {}, "source_sections": ["Feed exports"], "extraction_unit": "window", "domain_type": "scrapy", "taxonomy_id": "scrapy", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "asset_path": "family_root/macro_skill/workflow_skill/micro_skill_node", "asset_level": 3, "visible_role": "leaf", "candidate_slot": 1, "window_id": "f3e47eb6-bd9a-52b5-9ca4-015daa496e3f", "window_strategy": "strict", "anchor_hits": [], "paragraph_start": 32, "paragraph_end": 36, "heading_path": ["Feed exports"], "parent_heading": "", "sibling_headings": ["input001\feed-exports.md"], "subsection_headings": ["Serialization formats", "JSON", "JSON lines", "CSV", "XML", "Pickle", "Marshal", "Storages", "Storage URI parameters", "Local filesystem", "FTP", "S3", "Google Cloud Storage (GCS)", "Standard output", "Delayed file delivery", "Item filtering", "ItemFilter", "Post-Processing", "Built-in Plugins", "Custom Plugins", "Settings", "FEEDS", "FEED_EXPORT_ENCODING", "FEED_EXPORT_FIELDS", "FEED_EXPORT_INDENT", "FEED_STORE_EMPTY", "FEED_STORAGES", "FEED_STORAGE_FTP_ACTIVE", "FEED_STORAGE_S3_ACL", "FEED_STORAGES_BASE", "FEED_EXPORTERS", "FEED_EXPORTERS_BASE", "FEED_EXPORT_BATCH_ITEM_COUNT", "FEED_URI_PARAMS"], "context_snippets": [], "heading_number": "", "heading_kind": "outline_llm", "section_summary": "One of the most frequently required features when implementing scrapers is"}}], "supports": [{"support_id": "e00b492a-21fb-5848-b6dd-66d69c5cf830", "doc_id": "f7a76d82-16fa-5d4e-9e08-dcfb60e9f311", "section": "Feed exports", "excerpt": "For example, to include the [`name`](spiders.html#scrapy.Spider.name) of the
source spider in the feed URI:

1. Define the following function somewhere in your project:

```
# myproject/utils.py
def uri_params(params, spider):
    return {**params, "spider_name": spider.name}
```
2. Point `FEED_URI_PARAMS` to that function in your settings:

```
# myproject/settings.py
FEED_URI_PARAMS = "myproject.utils.uri_params"
```
3. Use `%(spider_name)s` in your feed URI:

```
scrapy crawl <spider_name> -o "%(spider_name)s.jsonl"
```", "relation_type": "support", "confidence": 0.85}], "target_state": "active"}
